```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


# Overview
This analysis investigates MAVE flow-seq scores for variants associated with previously established GBA1 structural features.

1. N-Linked glycosylation residues
2. Domain I: Disulfide bridge residues
3. Catalytic cavity residues
4. SapC interactor residues
5. LIMP-2 interactor residues

## Required packages

```{r packages}
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(ggiraph)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(ggbeeswarm)
```


## Load raw data
```{r load-data}

MasterFile_Input <- readxl::read_excel("Supplementary Table 2_MAVE Master File.xlsx")

Mave_Annotated <- MasterFile_Input %>%
  mutate(
    Residue = paste0(WT_AA, Position),
    Barcode_Group = ifelse(
      MAVE_Barcode_Count >= 3,
      "≥3 barcodes",
      "<3 barcodes"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Residue, Variant, Position, WT_AA, Mutant_AA,
    MAVE_Score, MAVE_Barcode_Count,
    MAVE_Empirical_p_Value, MAVE_Empiracal_p_Interpretation, Barcode_Group)
```
  
# Stop Codon Score Calculation
Calculate the average stop codon score of GBA1 variants from the MAVE flow-seq dataset
  
```{r Stop-codon Calculation}
####Stop Codon Analysis####
GBAAnalysisStopCodon <- MasterFile_Input %>%
  mutate(Position = as.numeric(Position)) %>%
  filter(
    WT_AA != Mutant_AA,
    Mutant_AA == "*",
    !is.na(MAVE_Score),
    Position > 20
  )

stop_median <- median(
  GBAAnalysisStopCodon$MAVE_Score,
  na.rm = TRUE
)
```  

## Analysis of N-Linked Glycosylation Residues

```{r N linked glycosylation analysis}
# 1 Identify N linked glycosylation residues
N_Linked_Glycosylation_Residues <- c("N58", "N98", "N185", "N309")

# 2 Filter data
Mave_Glyco <- Mave_Annotated %>%
  filter(
    Residue %in% N_Linked_Glycosylation_Residues,
    !is.na(MAVE_Score)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Significant = MAVE_Empirical_p_Value < 0.05
  )

#Preserve desired order
Mave_Glyco$Residue <- factor(
  Mave_Glyco$Residue,
  levels = N_Linked_Glycosylation_Residues
)

# 3 Count variants per residue
Count_df <- Mave_Glyco %>%
  group_by(Residue) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n()
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    y = 0.4
  )


# 4 N Linked Glycosylation Plot 
NLinked_Glycosylation_Plot <- ggplot(
  Mave_Glyco,
  aes(
    x = Residue,
    y = MAVE_Score
  )
) +
  
  # Boxplots
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "white",
    outlier.shape = NA,
    width = 0.6,
    linewidth = 0.1
  ) +
  
  # Individual variants
  geom_quasirandom_interactive( 
    aes( colour = Significant, 
         shape = Barcode_Group, 
         tooltip = paste0( 
           "<b>Mutation:</b> ", 
           Variant, "<br><b>Residue:</b> ", 
           round(MAVE_Score, 3), "<br><b>p value:</b> ", 
           signif(MAVE_Empirical_p_Value, 3), "<br><b>Barcodes:</b> ",
           MAVE_Barcode_Count ), data_id = Variant ), 
    width = 0.32, 
    size = 0.65, 
    alpha = 0.6, 
    stroke = 0.1 ) +
  
  # Sample sizes
  geom_text(
    data = Count_df,
    aes(
      x = Residue,
      y = y,
      label = paste0("n=", n)
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  
  # STOP control median line
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = stop_median,
    colour = "darkred",
    linewidth = 1,
    alpha = 0.15
  )+
  
  # Neutral reference
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    colour = "darkgreen",
    linewidth = 0.15,
    linetype = "dashed",
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  
  # Point colours
  scale_colour_manual( 
    values = c( "TRUE" = "red", "FALSE" = "black" ), 
    guide = "none" ) + 
  # Point shapes 
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c( "≥3 barcodes" = 16, "<3 barcodes" = 1 ), 
    guide = "none" ) +
  
  labs(  x = "N-linked Glycosylation Residue", y = "Flow-Seq Score") +
  
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c( -1.5, 0.5  )) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  
  theme(
    # backgrounds
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
    
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    
    # grid
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "gray90", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "gray90", linewidth = 0.1),
    
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    # axes
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7 ),
    
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.1),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm")
  )

# Save plot
ggsave("NLinkedGlycosylation.pdf", 
       plot = NLinked_Glycosylation_Plot,
       device = cairo_pdf,
       width = 80,
       height = 57,
       units = "mm")
```

# Analysis of Disulfide Bridge Residues


# Analysis of Cavity Lining

```{r Cavity lining analysis}

# Identify residues
Cavity_Residues <- c("R159",  "D166",  "F167",  "W218",  "N273", "E274", "Y283", 
                     "F285", "Y352", "E379", "C381", "S384", "W420", "N435", "F436", "V437") 
# Catalytic residues 
Cavity_Catalytic_Residues <- c("E274", "E379") 

# Catalytic cavity-lining residues 
Cavity_CavityLining_Residues <- c("R159",  "D166",  "F167",  "W218",  "N273", "Y283", 
                                  "F285", "Y352", "C381", "S384", "W420", "N435", "F436", "V437")



# 2 Filter cavity residues
Mave_Cavity <- Mave_Annotated %>% 
  filter( Residue %in% Cavity_Residues, !is.na(MAVE_Score) ) %>% 
  mutate(Cavity_Group = case_when(
    Residue %in% Cavity_Catalytic_Residues ~ "Catalytic", 
    Residue %in% Cavity_CavityLining_Residues ~ "Cavity lining", 
    TRUE ~ "Other" ),
    Significant = MAVE_Empirical_p_Value < 0.05)

Mave_Cavity$Residue <- factor(Mave_Cavity$Residue, levels = Cavity_Residues) 

# 3 Count variants per residue
Count_Cavity <- Mave_Cavity %>% 
  group_by(Residue) %>% 
  summarise( n = n(), .groups = "drop" ) %>% 
  mutate( y = 0.45 ) 

# 4 Create annotation strip
Cavity_Annotation <- data.frame( 
  Residue = factor( 
    Cavity_Residues, 
    levels = Cavity_Residues ) ) %>% 
  mutate(Cavity_Group = case_when(
    Residue %in% Cavity_Catalytic_Residues ~ "Catalytic",
    Residue %in% Cavity_CavityLining_Residues ~ "Cavity lining",
    TRUE ~ "Other" ), y = -1.43 )

# 5 Catalytic Cavity Plot

Cavity_Boxplot <- ggplot(
  Mave_Cavity,
  aes(
    x = Residue,
    y = MAVE_Score
  )
) +
  
  geom_boxplot( 
    fill = "white", 
    colour = "black", 
    outlier.shape = NA, 
    width = 0.6, 
    linewidth = 0.1 ) +
  
  # Individual variants 
  geom_quasirandom_interactive(
    aes(
      colour = Significant,
      shape = Barcode_Group,
      
      tooltip = paste0(
        "<b>Mutation:</b> ", Variant,
        "<br><b>Flow-Seq Score:</b> ", round(MAVE_Score, 3),
        "<br><b>p value:</b> ", signif(MAVE_Empirical_p_Value, 3),
        "<br><b>Barcodes:</b> ", MAVE_Barcode_Count,
        "<br><b>Cavity:</b> ", Cavity_Group
      ),
      
      data_id = Variant
    ),
    width = 0.32,
    size = 0.65,
    alpha = 0.6,
    stroke = 0.1
  ) +
  
  geom_text(
    data = Count_Cavity,
    aes(
      x = Residue,
      y = y,
      label = paste0("n=", n)
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 1.5,
    angle = 55,
    hjust = 0.5
  ) + 
  # Cavity annotation strip
  geom_tile(
    data = Cavity_Annotation,
    aes(
      x = Residue,
      y = y,
      fill = Cavity_Group
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.06
  ) +
  # Cavity group colours
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Catalytic Cavity Feature:",
    values = c(
      "Catalytic" = "#D95F02",
      "Cavity lining" = "#1B9E77",
      "Other" = "grey70"
    )
  ) +
  
  # STOP control median line
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = stop_median,
    colour = "darkred",
    linewidth = 1,
    alpha = 0.15
  )+
  
  # Neutral reference
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    colour = "darkgreen",
    linewidth = 0.15,
    linetype = "dashed",
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "TRUE" = "red",
      "FALSE" = "black"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "≥3 barcodes" = 16,
      "<3 barcodes" = 1
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Catalytic Cavity Residue",
    y = "Flow-Seq Score"
  ) +
  
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1.65, 0.5), clip = "off") +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "gray90", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "gray90", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, angle = 55, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.1),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm"),
    
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.18, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.15, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.05, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.03, "cm"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box.margin = margin(t = -5)
     )

print(Cavity_Boxplot)

ggsave("Cavity_Boxplot.pdf", 
              plot = Cavity_Boxplot,
       device = cairo_pdf,
       width = 80,
       height = 70,
       units = "mm")
```

# 4 Analysis of Sapc Interactor Residues 

```{r Sacp Interactor analysis}
# SAPC INTERACTORS + STRUCTURAL ELEMENT ANNOTATION
# 1 SapC-interacting residues
SapC_Closed_Only <- c("T408")
SapC_Open_Only <- c(
  "D354", "A359", "F386", "E388",
  "L483", "D484"
)
SapC_Closed_and_Open <- c(
  "F355", "L356", "A357", "P358",
  "K360", "K385", "W387", "R392",
  "D397", "Q401", "H404", "Y412",
  "K480", "D482", "R502", "S503",
  "S504", "Y526")

# All SapC interactors
SAPC_Residues <- unique(c(
  SapC_Closed_Only,
  SapC_Open_Only,
  SapC_Closed_and_Open
))


# 2. Structural elements
SapC_Loop1 <- c("D354", "F355", "L356", "A357", "P358")

SapC_Loop1_Helix6_Junction <- c( "A359")

SapC_Helix6 <- c( "K360")

SapC_Loop2 <- c( "K385", "F386", "W387", "E388")

SapC_Loop2_Helix7_Junction <- c("R392")

SapC_Helix7 <- c("D397", "Q401", "H404", "T408")

SapC_Helix7_Boundary <- c("Y412")

SapC_DomainII <- c("K480", "D482", "L483", "D484",
                   "R502", "S503", "S504", "Y526")


# 3 SAPC INTERACTORS — STRUCTURAL CLASSIFICATION
SapC_Structure <- data.frame(
  Residue = c(
    SapC_Loop1,
    SapC_Loop1_Helix6_Junction,
    SapC_Helix6,
    SapC_Loop2,
    SapC_Loop2_Helix7_Junction,
    SapC_Helix7,
    SapC_Helix7_Boundary,
    SapC_DomainII
  ),
  
  Structural_Element = c(
    rep("Loop 1", length(SapC_Loop1)),
    rep("Loop 1–Helix 6 junction", length(SapC_Loop1_Helix6_Junction)),
    rep("Helix 6", length(SapC_Helix6)),
    rep("Loop 2", length(SapC_Loop2)),
    rep("Loop 2–Helix 7 junction", length(SapC_Loop2_Helix7_Junction)),
    rep("Helix 7", length(SapC_Helix7)),
    rep("Helix 7 boundary", length(SapC_Helix7_Boundary)),
    rep("Domain II", length(SapC_DomainII))
  )
)



# 4 Filter MAVE data for SapC Interactors
Mave_SAPC <- Mave_Annotated %>%
  filter(
    Residue %in% SAPC_Residues,
    !is.na(MAVE_Score)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Significant = MAVE_Empirical_p_Value < 0.05
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    SapC_Structure,
    by = "Residue"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Position) %>%
  mutate(
    Residue = reorder(Residue, Position)
  )


# 5 Annotation data for structural strip
SAPC_Annotation <- SapC_Structure %>%
  mutate(
    Residue = factor(
      Residue,
      levels = SAPC_Residues
    ),
    y = -1.43
  )



# 6 Variant counts
Count_SAPC <- Mave_SAPC %>%
  group_by(Residue) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Residue = factor(
      Residue,
      levels = SAPC_Residues
    ),
    y = 0.4
  )

# 7 SapC Plot
SAPC_Boxplot <- ggplot(
  Mave_SAPC,
  aes(
    x = Residue,
    y = MAVE_Score
  )
) +
  
# Boxplots
geom_boxplot(
  fill = "white",
  colour = "black",
  outlier.shape = NA,
  width = 0.6,
  linewidth = 0.1
) +
  
# Individual variants
geom_quasirandom_interactive(
  aes(
    colour = Significant,
    shape = Barcode_Group,
    
    tooltip = paste0(
      "<b>Mutation:</b> ", Variant,
      "<br><b>Flow-Seq Score:</b> ",
      round(MAVE_Score, 3),
      "<br><b>p value:</b> ",
      signif(MAVE_Empirical_p_Value, 3),
      "<br><b>Barcodes:</b> ",
      MAVE_Barcode_Count,
      "<br><b>Structural location:</b> ",
      Structural_Element
    ),
    
    data_id = Variant
  ),
  width = 0.32,
  size = 0.65,
  alpha = 0.6,
  stroke = 0.1
) +
  
# Variant count
geom_text(
  data = Count_SAPC,
  aes(
    x = Residue,
    y = y,
    label = paste0("n=", n)
  ),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  size = 1.5,
  angle = 55,
  hjust = 0.5
) +
  
# Structural annotation strip
geom_tile(
  data = SAPC_Annotation,
  aes(
    x = Residue,
    y = y,
    fill = Structural_Element
  ),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  width = 0.9,
  height = 0.07
) +
  
# Structural colours
scale_fill_manual(
  name = "SapC\nInterface:",
  
  breaks = c(
    "Loop 1",
    "Loop 1–Helix 6 junction",
    "Helix 6",
    "Loop 2",
    "Loop 2–Helix 7 junction",
    "Helix 7",
    "Helix 7 boundary",
    "Domain II"
  ),
  labels = c(
    "Loop 1",
    "Loop 1–Helix 6\njunction",
    "Helix 6",
    "Loop 2",
    "Loop 2–Helix 7\njunction",
    "Helix 7",
    "Helix 7\nboundary",
    "Domain II"
  ),
  values = c(
    "Loop 1" = "#D95F02",
    "Loop 1–Helix 6 junction" =  "#E6AB02",
    "Helix 6" =  "#A6761D",
    "Loop 2" =  "#1B9E77",
    "Loop 2–Helix 7 junction" =  "#66A61E",
    "Helix 7" =  "#7570B3",
    "Helix 7 boundary" = "#6A3D9A",
    "Domain II" = "#E7298A"
  )) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "TRUE" = "red",
      "FALSE" = "black"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  
# Barcode shape
scale_shape_manual(
  values = c(
    "≥3 barcodes" = 16,
    "<3 barcodes" = 1
  ),
  guide = "none"
) +
  
  # STOP control median line
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = stop_median,
    colour = "darkred",
    linewidth = 1,
    alpha = 0.15
  )+
  
# Neutral reference
geom_hline(
  yintercept = 0,
  colour = "darkgreen",
  linewidth = 0.15,
  linetype = "dashed",
  alpha = 0.75
) +  
  
# Labels
labs(
  x = "SapC-Interface Residue",
  y = "Flow-Seq Score"
) +
  

# Coordinate limits
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1.65, 0.5), clip = "off") +
  
# Theme
theme_bw() +
  
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1 ),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "gray90",linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "gray90", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7,angle = 55,hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.1),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm"),
    
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.18,"cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.15, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.025, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.03,"cm"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box.margin = margin(t = -5))

print(SAPC_Boxplot)

ggsave("SAPC_Boxplot.pdf", 
              plot = SAPC_Boxplot,
       device = cairo_pdf,
       width = 90,
       height = 65,
       units = "mm")
```


# Analysis of LIMP-2 interface residues

```{r LIMP2 interface analysis}

# 1 LIMP2 binding residues
LIMP2_Binding_Residues <- c("L130", "N131", "L133", 
                            "A134", "L135", "S136", 
                            "I169", "R170", "E190", 
                            "E191", "K194", "L195", 
                            "N425", "E427", "P430", "R434", 
                            "D438", "S439", "P440", "I441", "I442", "V443", "D444",
                            "I445", "T446",
                            "K447",
                            "D448")

LIMP2_Interface_Hydrophobic_Core <- c("L130", "L133", 
                                      "A134", "L135", 
                                      "I169", "L195", 
                                      "P430",  "P440", 
                                      "I441", "I442", 
                                      "V443", "I445")

LIMP2_Interface_PolarChargedRim <- c("N131", "S136", "R170", "E190", 
                                     "E191", "K194", "N425", "E427", "R434",
                                     "D438", "S439", "D444", "K447",
                                     "T446", "D448")

LIMP2_Interface_HydrogenBond <- c("N131", "K194", "R434")
LIMP2_Interface_SaltBridge <- c("E190", "D448")

# 2 Filter for LIMP2 residues and define the structural category for each LIMP-2 binding residue
Mave_LIMP2 <- Mave_Annotated %>%
  filter(
    Residue %in% LIMP2_Binding_Residues,
    !is.na(MAVE_Score)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Significant = MAVE_Empirical_p_Value < 0.05,
    Interface_Group = case_when(
      Residue %in% LIMP2_Interface_SaltBridge ~ "Salt bridge",
      Residue %in% LIMP2_Interface_HydrogenBond ~ "Hydrogen bond",
      Residue %in% LIMP2_Interface_Hydrophobic_Core ~ "Hydrophobic core",
      Residue %in% LIMP2_Interface_PolarChargedRim ~ "Polar/charged rim",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

# Preserve residue order
Mave_LIMP2$Residue <- factor(
  Mave_LIMP2$Residue,
  levels = LIMP2_Binding_Residues
)

# 3 Count variants per residue
Count_LIMP2 <- Mave_LIMP2 %>%
  group_by(Residue) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    y = 0.45
  )

# 4 Create annotation strip
LIMP2_Annotation <- data.frame(
  Residue = factor(
    LIMP2_Binding_Residues,
    levels = LIMP2_Binding_Residues
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    Interface_Group = case_when(
      Residue %in% LIMP2_Interface_SaltBridge ~ "Salt bridge",
      Residue %in% LIMP2_Interface_HydrogenBond ~ "Hydrogen bond",
      Residue %in% LIMP2_Interface_Hydrophobic_Core ~ "Hydrophobic core",
      Residue %in% LIMP2_Interface_PolarChargedRim ~ "Polar/charged rim",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    y = -1.43
  )

# 4 LIMP2 plot
LIMP2_Boxplot <- ggplot(
  Mave_LIMP2,
  aes( x = Residue, y = MAVE_Score)) +
  
  # Boxplots
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "white",
    colour = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA,
    width = 0.6,
    linewidth = 0.1
  ) +
  
  # Individual variants
  geom_quasirandom_interactive(
    aes(
      colour = Significant,
      shape = Barcode_Group,
      tooltip = paste0(
        "<b>Mutation:</b> ", Variant,
        "<br><b>Flow-Seq Score:</b> ", round(MAVE_Score, 3),
        "<br><b>p value:</b> ", signif(MAVE_Empirical_p_Value, 3),
        "<br><b>Barcodes:</b> ", MAVE_Barcode_Count,
        "<br><b>Interface:</b> ", Interface_Group
      ),
      data_id = Variant
    ),
    width = 0.32,
    size = 0.65,
    alpha = 0.6,
    stroke = 0.1
  ) +
  
  # Sample size
  geom_text(
    data = Count_LIMP2,
    aes( x = Residue, 
         y = y,
         label = paste0("n=", n)
         ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 1.5,
    angle = 55,
    hjust = 0.5
  ) +
  
  # Interface annotation strip
  geom_tile(
    data = LIMP2_Annotation,
    aes(
      x = Residue,
      y = y,
      fill = Interface_Group
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    width = 0.9,
    height = 0.06
  ) +
  # STOP control median line
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = stop_median,
    colour = "darkred",
    linewidth = 1,
    alpha = 0.15
  )+
  
  # Neutral reference
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    colour = "darkgreen",
    linewidth = 0.15,
    linetype = "dashed",
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "TRUE" = "red",
      "FALSE" = "black"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  
  # Barcode shape
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c(
      "≥3 barcodes" = 16,
      "<3 barcodes" = 1
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  
  # Interface group colours
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = "LIMP-2 Interface:",
    breaks = c(
      "Hydrophobic core",
      "Polar/charged rim",
      "Hydrogen bond",
      "Salt bridge"
    ),
    values = c(
      "Hydrophobic core" = "#D95F02",
      "Polar/charged rim" = "#1B9E77",
      "Hydrogen bond" = "#7570B3",
      "Salt bridge" = "#E7298A"
    ),
    guide = guide_legend( nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE ) ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "LIMP-2 Interface Residue",
    y = "Flow-Seq Score",
  ) +
  
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1.65, 0.5), clip = "off") +
  
  theme_bw() +
  
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect( fill = "transparent",colour = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA,linewidth = 0.1),
    plot.background = element_rect( fill = "transparent", colour = NA ),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line( colour = "gray90", linewidth = 0.1 ),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "gray90", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text( size = 7,  angle = 55,  hjust = 1 ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text( size = 7 ),
    axis.title.y = element_text( size = 7, face = "bold"),
    axis.ticks = element_line( colour = "black", linewidth = 0.1 ),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(  0.1,  "cm" ),
    
    plot.title = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.18, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.15, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.05, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.03, "cm"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box.margin = margin(t = -5)
    )

print(LIMP2_Boxplot)

ggsave("LIMP2_Boxplot.pdf", 
       plot = LIMP2_Boxplot,
       device = cairo_pdf,
       width = 80,
       height = 70,
       units = "mm")
```


# Comparison of Regions: Catalytic Cavity / SapC Interface / LIMP-2 Interface 

```{r region comparison}

# 1 Annotate residues by structural group
Mave_Structure <- Mave_Annotated %>%
  filter(!is.na(MAVE_Score)) %>%
  mutate(
    Structure = case_when(
      Residue %in% Cavity_Residues ~ "Catalytic Cavity",
      Residue %in% SAPC_Residues ~ "SapC Interface",
      Residue %in% LIMP2_Binding_Residues ~ "LIMP-2 Interface",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Structure))


# 2 Filter
Mave_Structure_Median <- Mave_Structure %>%
  filter(Barcode_Group %in% "≥3 barcodes") %>%
  group_by(Structure, Residue) %>%
  summarise(
    Median_MAVE = median(MAVE_Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )



Mave_Structure_Median$Structure <- factor(
  Mave_Structure_Median$Structure,
  levels = c("Catalytic Cavity", "LIMP-2 Interface", "SapC Interface"))

# 3 Count residues
Count_Structure <- Mave_Structure_Median %>%
  group_by(Structure) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n()
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    y = 0.27
  )

# Plotting
Structure_Boxplot <- ggplot(
  Mave_Structure_Median,
  aes(
    x = Structure,
    y = Median_MAVE
  )
) +

  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "white",
    colour = "black",
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) + 
  

  geom_quasirandom_interactive(
    aes(
      tooltip = paste0(
        "<br><b>Residue:</b> ", Residue,
        "<br><b>Median Flow-Seq Score:</b> ", round(Median_MAVE, 3)
      ),
      data_id = Residue
    ),
    width = 0.32,
    size = 0.65,
    alpha = 0.6,
    stroke = 0.1
  ) +
  
  geom_text(
    data = Count_Structure,
    aes(
      x = Structure,
      y = y,
      label = paste0("N=", n)
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 2
  ) +
  # STOP control median line
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = stop_median,
    colour = "darkred",
    linewidth = 1,
    alpha = 0.15
  )+
  
  # Neutral reference
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    colour = "darkgreen",
    linewidth = 0.15,
    linetype = "dashed",
    alpha = 0.75
  )+
  
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Median Flow-Seq Score\n per residue"
  ) +
  
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c(
      "Catalytic Cavity" = "Catalytic\nCavity",
      "SapC Interface" = "SapC\nInterface",
      "LIMP-2 Interface" = "LIMP-2\nInterface"
    )
  )+
  

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-1.2, 0.35),
    breaks = seq(-1, 0.25, by = 0.25),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  )+
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "gray90", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = "gray90", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
    
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.1),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm")
  )

print(Structure_Boxplot)

ggsave("Cavity_SapC_LIMP2_Comp_Boxplot.pdf", 
              plot = Structure_Boxplot,
              device = cairo_pdf,
              width = 80,
              height = 65,
              units = "mm")
```
